findings.detail: Sorted source definitions enumerate every 3-5 source subset as a fixed tuple with local references. Pure deep-copy envelope helper hoists definitions to the actual schema root and is shared by generation and replay. Generic writer/resolver/render/pagebuilder/fact/text ASTs remain identical to frozen predecessor. No output merging or injected answer.

Replay checks exact trusted reconstructed schema before validating the envelope against that trusted schema. Coherently rehashed external-reference negative verifies the attacker schema is never consulted. The 21 new source tests retain valid subsets, same-source page grouping, count/order/foreign rejection, full SDK success/ACK and early duplicate rejection.

v2 uses exact integer-ratio floor into signed int64 microseconds and rejects bool/overflow/v1. Admission equivalence at 55 seconds is preserved with less than one microsecond display loss. Actual deadline and monotonic source unchanged. Final text and whole packet still pass original scanner; capture errors retain original failure and zero credit. Retained 31-test GREEN includes boundary and existing scanner negatives.

Existing assertions remain. Definition access adapts to the shared-root representation. Duplicate writer diagnostic fixture now injects at resolver boundary as foreign/unissued fixtures already did; an added full SDK duplicate test proves the ordinary path stops before writer dispatch. No weakening of writer defense was found.

Official pinned Python converter uses local reference resolution with allow_fetch=False. Seven retained passing cases cover complete 3/4/5 envelopes, pattern compatibility and original byte rejection. Six-page reconstructed sizing explicitly omits inherited SDK system/action history; it cannot establish actual request size or installed native-binary behavior.

Removal of only the phase-schema unchanged assertion matches the approved product change. Independent AST comparison confirms all six required generic functions and every harness function unchanged. Current-byte archived sources, successful JUnit cases and clean offline audits independently support 664 product + 275 deduplicated harness + 59 interface checks, excluding historical failures and two HTTP/junction tests.

Existing explicit diagnostics-then-evidence-repair sequence supports this bounded preparation. Entry binds exact decision, candidate, preparation manifest and review; requires fresh <=120-second one-case/one-result-review grant and retry=0, and exclusively consumes before execution. No actual/release root exists. This review allocates no case and does not reuse the spent diagnostic.

Frozen diagnosis supports the phase/writer contract mismatch, not a recovered exact duplicate ID; original write arguments and random failing decimal were not retained. Unknown-source alternative is not conclusively excluded. Historical N9 causes are not assigned and no old E01/E03 acceptance credit transfers.

limits: Read-only preparation review; existing tests were inspected and recounted, never rerun.
No model/product/network/UI/audio/service/process operations performed. Runtime identity is assessed only from the sealed read-only receipt; freshness must be enforced by the actual entry.
No actual inference, installed native-binary grammar proof, full actual-request sizing proof, semantic fact or original-topic coverage acceptance is established.
Only the existing conditional successor single-case allowance may proceed through original release prerequisites; no new authorization or retry is granted.
Original model, corpus, seven protected identities, operation/time/context/byte caps and zero retry remain unchanged.
No remote push retry or alternate channel; remote publication remains blocked by prior policy.
E02/T2 remain NOT_PASSED; even a subsequent independently accepted controlled result could earn at most this candidate 1/3, with no old credit transfer.
